title: Birthday Budget Overrun by Recipient Group
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birthday:spend
| search overrun_amount>0
| stats sum(overrun_amount) as overrun_amount count as recipients by recipient_group
| sort 0 - overrun_amount
description: Ranks recipient groupss by birthday budget overrun.
value: Recipient-group overruns show where generosity is repeatedly outpacing the envelope you intended.
implementation: Send birthday budget overrun events to `index=personal` and keep `recipient_group` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of birthday budget overrun by recipient groups.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which recipient groupss stand out most for birthday budget overrun.
